core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghafur is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Most forgiving”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghafur corresponds to the Arabic form غفور (Arabic root غ ف ر (gh-f-r); غَفور (Ghafūr)). Its core sense is ever-forgiving, most forgiving. Ghafur is a transliteration of Arabic غفور (Ghafūr) 'most forgiving'. The same word appears in this batch as ghafoor and in the previous batch as gafoor.
